statements: The overview specifies that biostimulatory injectables are used to support gradual tissue remodeling or collagen-related goals, with results generally being progressive rather than immediate.
The practice highlights realistic expectations and staged follow-up, noting that biostimulatory treatments should be distinguished from immediate-volume fillers when addressing educational questions.
strict_fact_review: Progressive collagen goals and staged follow-up represented; provider suitability qualification remains omitted. Exact citations valid; this is not complete H11 fact coverage.
